slices.focus: Nadia consolidates all system pieces into a written agency intake manual — triage, inspection, school support, volunteer roles.
slices.summary: Nadia spends weeks consolidating her intake system (triage, housing inspection, school support, volunteer roles, deadline escalation rules) into a written agency manual. She includes sample checklists, landlord-photo documentation standards (angles, appliances, damage, smoke detectors, windows), and clear escalation triggers. Daniel reviews the housing sections. She plans to train the highest-risk sections first (escalation rules, inspection docs), ask two staff to cold-test a checklist, and set up a revision process with section leads rather than owning every update herself.
open_loops: Train highest-risk sections first (escalation rules, inspection documentation)
Ask two staff to cold-test a checklist and report where they hesitate
Set up revision process with section leads on a trigger-based schedule
Roll out school support and volunteer sections in a separate chunk
